title: Sheepdog Runner
heading: Sheepdog
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Move the mouse over the stage: the dog follows it.

1.name: The dog follows the mouse
1.note: point towards (mouse-pointer), move 4, unless the mouse is close.

2.name: The sheep graze
2.note: 8 clones wander: a random turn, move 1, bounce off the edges.

3.name: The sheep run from the dog
3.note: distance to Dog < 70: point towards Dog, turn 180, move 3.

4.name: The pen and the clock
4.note: repeat until touching Pen; all 8 inside wins, the timer is the score. This is the whole game.
